title: Single-coordinate addition law
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $c\in\mathbb{F}_2$. Adding $c$ to coordinate $i$ changes the complete quadratic bit by $c\sum_{j\ne i}x_j$; that is, the new value is the original value plus this quantity in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
